summary: Alert when exported APIM metrics show requests but gateway logs are absent for a completed observation interval. Idle traffic does not alert. Requires independent metrics and logs export to the selected workspace.
verification: Independently validate KQL against the actual workspace schema, check idle/no-alert and traffic-with-missing-logs/alert cases, test action delivery with approval. Failure of both export streams is a documented blind spot.

allOf.query: let target = '/subscriptions/{{subscriptionId}}/resourceGroups/{{resourceGroup}}/providers/Microsoft.ApiManagement/service/{{serviceName}}'; let traffic = AzureMetrics | where TimeGenerated between (ago(30m) .. ago(10m)) | where ResourceId =~ target and MetricName == 'Requests' | summarize Requests=sum(Total); let logs = ApiManagementGatewayLogs | where TimeGenerated between (ago(30m) .. ago(10m)) | where _ResourceId =~ target | summarize Logged=count(); traffic | extend JoinKey=1 | join kind=inner (logs | extend JoinKey=1) on JoinKey | where Requests > 0 and Logged == 0 | project Requests, Logged
